# SPD-041 — Bash hook: a glob in the command word or a git verb hides the command (Law 7)

## Brief
analyse_segment takes the command word and git verb as spelled. Both shells expand an unquoted glob there before running it, so a member can run a git write through a path glob such as /usr/bin/g?t or a zsh alternation g(i|x)t, or a verb glob matching a file it created (touch push, then p?sh). SPD-034 expands globs only in redirection and tee targets; SPD-039 only fixes zsh operators in targets. Outside SPD-039's brief.

Evidence: analyse_command reads /usr/bin/g?t push and /usr/bin/g(i|x)t push as kind other with no git finding (SPD-039 scratchpad). Probe zsh 5.9 -o nobareglobqual: /bin/ech(o) hello ran /bin/echo and printed hello; with bareglobqual (o) is read as a qualifier and errors, but an alternation such as (i|x) is a group under both options. Fix sketch: when the command word or the git verb holds an active glob (GLOB_RE, or SPD-039's zsh sentinels), refuse a member (an unresolvable command word, like a variable) or expand it against PATH and the candidate directories within the SPD-034 budget.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on opus, no children: one hook fix in bin/spud_ledger.py with red-first tests, the same shape as SPD-034 and SPD-039, built in worktree spd-041-glob-command-word.

- **Bash hook: a VCS alias defined on the command line with -c alias.NAME=VERB runs a write verb under a name Law 7's table does not hold** — origin [[SPUD-041/Roseval]] — decision: created as [[SPD-044]] at P1.

## Outcome
Every word the Bash hook dispatches on by name, from the command word and wrappers to git options and verb, shell and python options and spud call arguments, is now read as each checked name a glob, brace list, zsh alternation or range, or equals expansion can become, plus its spelling. A glob that can match two checked names refuses a member, and sh -c, eval and script -c strings are deglobbed. The =(cmd) regression from SPD-039 is fixed. GlobCommandWordTest 13 methods, red first. Suite 513 OK, rerun by Spud. Merged into main. Proposals became SPD-043 and SPD-044.
